subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- November 25, 2026
body:
Subject: AcreetionOS-Xlibre updates to latest Electron for new users

AcreetionOS-Xlibre now includes the latest Electron for new users, which is exactly the kind of unglamorous maintenance that keeps a young distro feeling current. The same day, the project also shows a tiny but useful fix: the bottom bar icon is clickable again, and the smile in the message makes the whole thing feel appropriately human.

Development
The AcreetionOS-Xlibre repository received two changes worth noticing: an Electron update aimed at new users, and a fix for the bottom bar icon that had been ignoring clicks. Those small desktop details matter more than they look, especially when the interface is the first thing a newcomer sees. You can follow the moving parts through the changelog at https://acreetionos.org/changelog.html or start exploring the project at https://acreetionos.org/.

Community
Outside our own trees, the Arch-adjacent neighborhood stayed busy. Firefox 161.0 landed, CachyOS published its November 2026 release, and the security update rhythm continued across the ecosystem. Meanwhile, the site archive synced with newsletter and wiki guides, a Lysator mirror in Linkoping, Sweden was added, and the natalie and cobra3282000 accounts remain the visible home of internal collaboration on the AcreetionOS GitLab instance.

Tip of the day
If you are testing AcreetionOS in a VM or on an old spare laptop, keep a second terminal open before you touch desktop icons or bottom-bar widgets. The latest Xlibre commits are small, but they are exactly the sort of change you want to verify with a quick restart and a clean login. For setup notes and the friendlier long-form docs, the wiki at https://acreetionos.org/wiki.html is the right corner of the internet to bookmark.
